SproutTales is an AI-powered picture book generator that turns a single idea into a fully illustrated children's storybook — with consistent characters, leveled reading text, and print-ready PDFs for Amazon KDP.

## What we do

- Write stories from a one-sentence prompt
- Maintain character consistency across all pages using a reference card system
- Match reading levels from GRL A to E
- Export spec-compliant interior and full-cover PDFs for KDP
- Support 10 languages natively
- Offer a Free plan and paid plans starting at $12/month

## Who it's for

- Parents who want a personalized book for their child
- Teachers looking for leveled reading materials
- Self-publishers on Amazon KDP
- Gift-givers wanting a unique, meaningful present

## Key differentiators

- Character consistency enforced on every page
- Monthly book allowance (no per-creation charges)
- Optional credit packs that never expire
- Privacy-first: parents control photo usage
- KDP-ready PDFs with correct bleed, gutter, and spine width

## Pricing

- Free: 1 book (8 pages, 3 styles, preview only)
- Starter: $12/month (10 books, watermark-free PDF)
- Creator: $29/month (KDP export, commercial license, narration)
- Studio: $59/month (100 books, batch generation)
